name: Supine Spine Twist
summary: Lying on the back with the knees together, both knees sway to one side and the obliques draw them back to centre.
steps: Lie on the back, arms wide, knees bent and squeezed together.
Breathe in to let both knees sway to one side; the far shoulder stays down.
Breathe out to bring them back through centre with the waist.

layers.title: Legs in tabletop
layers.text: The knees stay level with each other.

layers.title: Straighten the legs at the side
layers.text: Only as far as the shoulder stays down.

cautions.note: Not lying flat after the first 12 weeks.
Keep the range small and the feet down.

cues:
Knees and ankles stay glued.
The waist brings the legs back, not the legs.
Opposite shoulder heavy.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
